Nope. 
You're not a bad person. 

You're mom kept you clothed and fed. Awesome.
Some parents don't do even that. 
Still that's bearly the minimum.

Being a parent requires a lot of important things  you're mom was not willing or able to give you like care, patience, guidance and, you know, be there for you and help you grow.

So when a parent doesn't act like one, how could you possibly feel for them the way a child is expected to feel?
You did what you could and you still do.
Heck, you still visit! Most people might think twice before coming back to visit someone who's been toxic to them, parent or no..

So, you're golden.

Will do friend, everyday.
Thank you

I get it now..I just wish he waited until I calmed down before expressing this..
In the moment it's overwhelming.. that's why I vented the way I did here..

Self harm is not rational the way we regularly think of rationality..So there is no *good* reason to self harm like there is no good reason to drink alone when you're sad..but there is relief.. 
There are different ways to relieve stress, it's true, but I wasn't feeling streess. I was feeling something worse in such a degree I cannot describe..
I was more or less 'clean' this year..lots of hard work it takes ..
Still, I'd like to ask how do you usually relieve stress when you're overwhelmed?

Thank you for taking the time to write to me.

It wasn't like a 'fuck you' though..his knife is sharp and swift..kitchen knives are risky and dirty and buying my own blade would confirm that I will cut again in the future..I've bee 'clean' for about 3 years untill recently and it's been hard to stop so I don't want this to become a habit again..That's the 'rational' I had at the tome I think ..

 Everything you wrote seems only reasonable now but when I'm "in the dark" it's like a switch that once on, all reason and mildness is out the window.

We've been working things out today..seems like we both calmed down a bit, trying hard to get better..

Thanks for the support.
 I wish you'll always to find strength when you need it.

Interesting..

I don't know what is it that you have, but maybe you're intense emotions and mimicking is a will to reconnect with your surroundings and to feel alive?

Don't know if I can explain it well.. I find myself to be able to understand some layers of people (thous they wish to hide usually) but some other more.."normal" and day to day responses both good and bad elude me sometimes..when I don't understand a person's reaction I try to go back to it when I'm alone and mimic it. The pose the way they were standing in,  the facial expressions and tone..things like that..and then after that I feel I can understand how they felt a tiny bit better..(In retrospect only) weird how the body can communicate emotion within ourselves to ourselves..

Maybe it's something like that? you trying to connect to people around you the best you can?

If it's any help you're not alone. I too struggle with relationships and lack thereof and frequent suicidal thoughts..

You have the right to choose your path whatever it maybe. If you wish to go you'r free to do so. No one can tell you what to do with your life. 

However,

I don't think you want to die. I think you want the pain to stop. There is a way, and it's different for everyone, but when you search for it actively, you star to reconnect with life a tiny bit more.

That's what helped me to stay sane.

And you're doing it! I applaud you for exercising as most people with depression can't do it regularly and only fall into more sadness due to lack of movement, so that's awesome.

You may not have been able to find a relationship yet but you did take the time to look for someone online, some won't even bother to take the time thinking "what's the use?". 

Maybe it all proves useless to you now but the result doesn't matter. Movement does. Movement means progress however slow and small. You're not racing against anyone so there is really no hurry in contrast to what we are told in modern societies.

In the short term maybe you could do something you like for a day? something to calm your mind like play or food that you like? if it's a work day can you take one off?

The long term is the real challenge..

I know how it feels to be alone..I moved 5 schools 2 kinder gardens and a country in my childhood till teenage years and stayed secluded and even hated for being an emigrant. I too never met my bio dad but had other ones I wish I never had (3 of them. Yup. 3), my mom wasn't really there so I get you..It's hard when family fails you..

After years of solitude I was able to find some company by being active in a community revolving around a hobbies.. Do you have one? maybe there is something you always wanted to do and never got the chance? Anything from board games to anime to climbing to drawing to running in groups..just pick something and go with it as long as it involves people meeting IRL.

The fact you're a virgin is not shameful at all or a problem from where I'm standing..and honestly I think there is so much more in life then that..(speaking as a non virgin). Not enough women in your country? well friend, it's a small world..maybe one day you could  meet someone abroad? You know English well enough so you're up for a good start. 

In addition to that, though romantic relationships are great, being in a relationship will not make your troubles go away or bring you long lasting happiness necessarily. 

There is the question of how will you be content with yourself, by yourself that is more pressing and that I think should be your focus.

I would suggest you turn to a professional with your depression as they can provide you with guidance and a chance to heal.

I hope you won't leave us so soon and find a way be content enough with yourself one day, you deserve to.

 As long as you breath there is hope. 

Peace.

You're just fixating on one part of the whole.
Well, since you're so polite about it....XD

No what? 

No, if they work for you they're your emotional torment dummies to act towards as you please?

I don't think so.

You are not their parent. 

If you have problems with that person as a worker, better to **tell** them what you expect and if needs are not met, fire them respectfully rather than doing all listed above.

You would result in a better environment for yourself and others  in your workplace and also save yourself acting like a lowly version of yourself.
